qualification.details: Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering/ Environmental Engineering/Energy Engineering or Material Science. 3 or more internationally referred high-quality SCI (Science Citation Index) journal articles, as a first author from his/her Ph.D. research. Hands-on experience on Characterization (XRD, FESEM, TEM, BET, XRF, XPS etc) and quantification equipment (COD, BOD, TOC, GC-MS, LC-MS) along with continuous flow experiments.

Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.

Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Post Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Post Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Roorkee is 20-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Post Doctoral Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Energy Engineering, or Material Science, along with specific publication and hands-on experience requirements.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Post Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive Rs. 80,000 (+ HRA) per month, along with Rs. 50,000 per year for contingency expenses.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email to [email protected], including a covering letter, CV, PhD degree, publications list, and research statement.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for this Post Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: This is a project-based position at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q7. What specific experience is required for the Post Doctoral Fellow role?
faq.answer: Hands-on experience with characterization equipment (like XRD, FESEM, TEM) and quantification equipment (like COD, BOD, GC-MS) is required.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Post Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Post Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Roorkee located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee is located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand, with the pincode 247667.

faq.question: Q10. What is the brief description of the project for which this fellowship is advertised?
faq.answer: The fellowship is for a project focused on scale-up studies for industrial effluent treatment.
